test.name: Fuzz ipc_server_frame_decode for 5 minutes on this Mac

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run ipc_server_frame_decode runs the client side daemon frame decoder target for 300 seconds with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz and finds no crash.
actual: no crash and fuzz/artifacts/ipc_server_frame_decode/ empty; 4077978 runs in 301 s (13548 exec/s), cov 8093, ft 19129, corpus 3258 inputs (2347 KB), peak RSS 611 MB
steps: on commit e4d7e8b with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 (rustc 1.101.0-nightly 5d8fec066 2026-10-16) and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2, already installed for the existing IPC targets

run `cargo xtask fuzz run ipc_server_frame_decode` with the default --time 300; xtask checks both pins and fuzz/Cargo.lock, then runs libFuzzer with -max_len=65536 -max_total_time=300 on fuzz/corpus/ipc_server_frame_decode plus the committed fuzz/seeds/ipc_server_frame_decode (46 seeds, every ServerFrame fixture), built by cargo-fuzz with AddressSanitizer; the command ran from 2026-10-19T22:35:56Z to 22:44:16Z, building first and then fuzzing for 301 s
check that the command exits 0 with `ran for 300 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ipc_server_frame_decode/ holds no input, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the head and tail of the run log in this record's files folder
